baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَظْلَمُ ... ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ
baseline_models.mechanism: The disjunction pairs an outgoing false attribution with an incoming refusal. One places invented speech upon God where it does not belong; the other withholds recognition from a fixed claim when it arrives. Both operations instantiate the focus root's images of misplacement and detention from a right.

activation_trace.role: Misplacing a thing supplies the common structure joining false attribution to wrongful reception.
Withholding from a right makes denial an active detention of what is due, not mere nonrecognition.
Invented falsehood supplies the outward production that is falsely assigned to God.
Attributing falsity supplies the answering operation performed upon the truth and links noun and verb.
A fixed and binding due explains why refusal is withholding rather than neutral hesitation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists two especially serious forms of lying.
changed_reading.after: The ayah identifies one maximal injustice with two directions: projecting a counterfeit claim onto God and blocking a binding truth that has reached the hearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَمَّا جَآءَهُۥ ... فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus moves from an encounter in motion to a condition of residence. Truth comes to the person; denial covers it; the rhetorical question then presents a settled lodging for the resulting category of coverers. A moment of reception is converted into an abiding relation.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and obtaining make the truth a reached encounter rather than a remote proposition.
Covering supplies the response that occludes what has arrived.
Obstruction of truth identifies the residents by the operation they perform.
Long settlement turns a punctual refusal into a durable destination.
The negative interrogative functions as emphatic adjudication that the lodging is not absent.

changed_reading.before: Truth is denied and Hell is later assigned as punishment.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a transformation from reached truth, through deliberate covering, into settled residence; the destination answers the mode of reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening testing sequence turns professions into material to be assayed and separates what is solid from what is false. The focus ayah then reads as the surah's terminal diagnosis of claims that failed disclosure, with the fire image carrying an additional material resonance.

activation_trace.role: Assaying a person as metal makes an untested profession the input to a revealing process.
Burning and blackening supply the furnace image that can echo, without equating, the focus lodging in fire.
Solidity and straightness give the truthful side of the disclosed split a material stability.
Contrariety to truth names the failed class disclosed by the assay.
The doubled focus root gathers both producing and rejecting falsehood into that terminal class.

structural_cues: 29:2 poses an untested profession; 29:3 answers with testing and a truthful-liar split.
29:68 returns to the lie-denial pair at the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, fire, solidity, and the disclosed truthful-liar split; I infer that 29:68 closes that testing arc and that Hell intensifies the assay image. A live alternative is that the opening test and final fire remain adjacent moral themes without a single material process.

changed_reading.before: The focus independently condemns lying and denial.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also a closing assay report: claimed allegiance has been exposed as either solid truthfulness or fabricated and denying falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise to carry another's faults is itself called a lie, while the next ayah replaces that fictive transfer with actual accumulated loads and questioning about fabrication. The focus lie against God therefore reads as an attempted rewriting of liability whose weight cannot be reassigned by speech.

activation_trace.role: Guaranteeing another's burden supplies the false social contract offered by the speakers.
The packet itself classifies that guarantee as contrary to truth.
Bearing liability replaces the promised transfer with responsibility that remains attached.
Load made heavy materializes the consequences generated by the false guarantee.
Fabrication is the conduct about which the burden-bearers are questioned.
The focus repeats fabrication at the point where false liability is assigned to God.

structural_cues: 29:12 offers a transfer of faults and immediately denies that the speakers can carry them.
29:13 answers with their own loads, added loads, and questioning about what they fabricated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a false guarantee, nontransferable carrying, added weight, and fabrication; I infer that falsely speaking upon God attempts to authorize a liability map that reality reverses. The live alternative is a narrower reading in which the burden episode concerns social inducement only.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication against God is primarily a false statement.
changed_reading.after: It is also an attempted counterfeit allocation of responsibility: speech promises to move guilt, but the fabrication returns as added weight borne by its producers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collocation of fashioning and falsehood in 29:17 makes fabrication productive: a false worship-system is made, not merely uttered. The next denial passage states that clear delivery is complete. The focus's two clauses consequently form a sequence in which a manufactured counterfeit is maintained by rejecting the delivered truth.

activation_trace.role: Inventing false speech supplies explicit manufacture rather than accidental error.
Falsehood diverted from truth is the object produced by that manufacture.
Turning a thing from its proper direction explains how the counterfeit redirects worship and dependence.
Repeated attribution of falsity shows denial operating as the counterfeit system's defensive response.
Delivery of the message supplies the completed incoming side that denial answers.
The focus fabrication names the productive act now read through the earlier manufacture.

structural_cues: 29:17 joins the verbs of worship and fashioning to a falsehood that cannot provide.
29:18 immediately shifts from produced falsehood to repeated denial and clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manufacture, diverted falsehood, failed provision, denial, and completed delivery; I infer a causal sequence in which the made system survives by rejecting what reaches it. An alternative is that 29:17's production is only idiomatic speech and not a durable social artifact.

changed_reading.before: The two focus offenses are parallel but separable speech acts.
changed_reading.after: They can be successive operations of one counterfeit system: fabricate an alternative sacred order, then deny delivered truth to preserve it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah depicts people barred from the path while possessing inward sight, then a messenger arriving with clear proofs followed by self-magnification. Later, knowledgeable denial of signs is labeled first by covering and then by wrongdoing. The focus compresses that chain: truth reaches an agent capable of recognition, but a maintained obstruction converts sight into denial.

activation_trace.role: Turning away and diverting supplies an active barrier between insight and the path.
Inward sight keeps the obstruction from reducing to simple lack of perception.
The coming of clear proofs prefigures the focus truth's completed arrival.
Self-exaltation supplies a motive that blocks reception despite arrival.
Denial with knowledge makes the later rejection epistemically charged.
The packet labels knowledgeable sign-deniers as those who cover truth.
The repeated knowledgeable denial stabilizes the category across the textual section.
Calling the same deniers wrongdoers joins withholding the right to the focus superlative.
The focus arrival is the final compact anchor for the repeated proof-then-obstruction pattern.

structural_cues: 29:38 juxtaposes being diverted from the path with possessing sight.
29:39 orders arrival of proofs before self-magnification.
29:47 and 29:49 repeat knowledgeable denial while alternating the labels coverers and wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, obstruction, arrived proofs, pride, and denial-with-knowledge; I infer that 29:68's timing marks culpable obstruction rather than informational failure. A live alternative is that the sight in 29:38 is worldly cleverness and that deception, not fully conscious refusal, mediates the denial.

changed_reading.before: The denier may simply fail to recognize the truth that appears.
changed_reading.after: The focus targets a more active pathology: arrived evidence meets available insight, but pride and diversion maintain a knowing obstruction that the surah names both covering and injustice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit denial that God wronged prior peoples, followed by the reflexive statement that they wronged themselves, redirects the focus's Hell lodging away from arbitrary placement. Their own acts of misplacement and withholding become the path by which they are sited in the stated residence.

activation_trace.role: Misplacement spans the paired negation of divine wrongdoing and assertion of self-wronging.
Withholding a right makes the reflexive harm an operation the agents perform upon their own due order.
The superlative gathers that self-damaging misplacement into its most severe form.
Settled residence is the spatial result to which the self-directed misplacement is linked.

structural_cues: 29:40 grammatically contrasts God's non-wronging with repeated reflexive self-wronging.
29:68 moves from maximal wrongdoing to a rhetorical assertion of lodging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit agency contrast and the focus supplies residence; I infer the directional arrow from self-wronging to self-siting in that residence. The live alternative is that 29:40 assigns responsibility without making the later lodging spatially self-produced.

changed_reading.before: Hell is an externally imposed place for offenders.
changed_reading.after: The lodging is also the settled spatial consequence of their own misplacement: God does not wrong them into it; their response to truth sites them there.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three habitation images create a topology around the focus: false protectors form the weakest shelter, Hell already encloses the coverers, and believers are deliberately lodged in elevated enduring rooms. The focus mathwa is therefore not a generic penalty but the assigned habitat that answers a failed shelter and contrasts with stable lodging above flowing rivers.

activation_trace.role: Shelter and dwelling make false patronage an attempted habitat rather than only an abstract alliance.
Loss of strength exposes that chosen shelter as structurally unable to hold.
Sensible enclosure changes Hell from a distant point to surrounding space.
The same covering category named in the focus is already the object of enclosure.
Causing someone to take a settled place supplies the positive act of assigned habitation.
Upper rooms furnish the elevated counterpart to the focus residence.
Durable remaining supplies stability to the positive habitat.
The focus lodging becomes the adjudicated counterpart within this competing habitat system.

structural_cues: 29:41 evaluates a chosen house by structural weakness.
29:54 uses a nominal clause to present Hell as encompassing the coverers.
29:58 promises deliberate lodging in enduring upper rooms.
29:68 asks rhetorically about a lodging for the same covering class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weak shelter, encompassing Hell, assigned upper rooms, and focus lodging; I infer a comparative habitat system and a movement from chosen shelter to fitting residence. Alternatives remain: the images may be independent comparisons, and 29:54's enclosure may express certainty rather than present spatial condition.

changed_reading.before: Mathwa denotes a destination in Hell.
changed_reading.after: Mathwa completes a housing contrast: the false shelter cannot hold, Hell already closes around its dependents, while faithful action receives a deliberately placed and enduring upper habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the focus, speakers correctly name God as creator, exclusive devotion emerges when competing supports are stripped away at sea, and association returns after rescue. A secure sanctuary then becomes the setting for trusting falsehood and covering blessing. The focus denial when truth comes is thus situation-dependent suppression of recognized dependence, especially once safety permits counterfeit trust to return.

activation_trace.role: Being turned from the proper direction follows an explicit correct answer about the creator.
Exclusive separation from partnership exposes recognized dependence when rival supports disappear.
Association's immediate return after rescue supplies the reversal from exposed recognition to restored counterfeit allegiance.
Covering a gift makes the post-rescue reversal an occlusion of received benefit.
A protected sacred precinct supplies the spatial gift within which the reversal occurs.
Heart-settling trust links the safe condition and the paradoxical act of crediting falsehood.
A claim with no reality names the counterfeit object that receives trust.
Good condition and gift identify what is present yet covered.
Covering the blessing states the inverse operation to trusting the unreal.
The focus denial names the active reassignment of credibility after recognition.

structural_cues: 29:61 records a correct answer about God before asking how they are turned.
29:65 places exclusive devotion before rescue and association immediately after it.
29:66-67 link covering to received benefit and pair trust in falsehood with covering God's blessing.
29:68 follows without a change of addressee or topic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correct confession, crisis exclusivity, post-rescue association, protected space, counterfeit trust, and covered gift; I infer that the focus describes suppression of recognized truth under restored security. A live alternative is unstable crisis behavior without durable inward recognition.

changed_reading.before: The denier rejects truth because it is alien or unrecognized.
changed_reading.after: The denier repeatedly recognizes the source of creation, rescue, and security, then reallocates trust to falsehood and covers the gift once safety restores competing attachments.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayah immediately after the focus supplies the opposite response pattern. In 29:68 truth comes and is blocked, ending in settlement; in 29:69 exertion is answered by gentle guidance into multiple extended paths and divine accompaniment. Arrival is therefore a fork between covering that closes into residence and effort that opens further movement.

activation_trace.role: Expending capacity under difficulty supplies the responsive movement opposed to denial.
Gentle direction toward path and truth supplies the answering movement from God.
Extended traversable paths keep the successful response open and mobile.
Truth's arrival supplies the encounter from which the two response trajectories can be compared.
Fixed residence supplies the closed trajectory opposed to guided travel.

structural_cues: 29:68 ends with settled lodging after denial at arrival.
29:69 begins with responsive striving and promises guidance into plural paths.
The two ayat close the surah as adjacent conditional trajectories.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent arrival, denial, residence, striving, guidance, and paths; I infer a deliberate motion-versus-settlement response fork. The live alternative is that 29:69 is a general concluding promise rather than a direct spatial antithesis to 29:68.

changed_reading.before: The focus closes the warning, and the next ayah separately encourages effort.
changed_reading.after: The closing pair makes reception kinetic: covering arrived truth hardens into a lodging, while exerting oneself toward God elicits guidance into expanding paths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates secondary craft and garment branches rather than the primary false-speech senses. It remains anchored in the focus roots ف ر ي, ك ذ ب, and ح ق ق and coherently contrasts cutting, deceptive appearance, and firm weaving. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for counterfeit construction, not as the lexical meaning of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair and stitching supplies the constructive craft behind an assembled counterfeit.
Tearing and corruptive cutting supplies the damage concealed by the crafted appearance.
A decorated garment that lies by its condition supplies deceptive surface credibility.
Firmly woven speech supplies the structurally sound counterpart rejected by the counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is the assertion of an untrue proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fabrication resembles a stitched and decorated counterfeit whose convincing surface both imitates and tears against the tightly woven integrity of truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the no-delay sense belongs to an idiom within the ك ذ ب inventory, not directly to the focus Form II verb. It remains worth carrying because the focus explicitly says truth was denied when it came and then contrasts that punctual encounter with ث و ي residence. Downstream prose should call it a temporal resonance, never a grammatical gloss.

activation_trace.role: The idiomatic image of not lingering supplies a cautious resonance of immediate response.
Arrival fixes the event at which the swift refusal occurs.
Long settlement supplies the duration into which the brief refusal hardens.

changed_reading.before: Denial follows arrival and is punished by residence.
changed_reading.after: As a contained temporal resonance, a refusal made with no receptive interval crystallizes into the opposite duration: prolonged settlement.

strongest_changes: The two focus offenses became directional halves of one injustice: projecting counterfeit speech onto God and withholding a binding truth that has arrived.
The burden sequence made fabrication an attempted rewrite of liability whose promised transfer returns as actual weight.
Repeated insight, arrived proofs, and denial-with-knowledge changed the focus from informational failure to maintained obstruction.
The housing sequence changed mathwa into one element of a competing habitat system: weak false shelter, encompassing Hell, and enduring upper lodging.
The immediate pre-focus sequence made denial a post-recognition reversal in which rescue and security are received, then their source is covered while falsehood receives trust.
The final ayah turned arrival into a response fork between closed settlement and guided movement along paths.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted abstract truth and falsehood into operations with material and spatial consequences: claims are assayed, counterfeits manufactured, liabilities carried, shelters tested, gifts covered, and responses routed either into residence or into paths.
remaining_uncertainties: The textile model and the no-delay resonance rely on secondary or form-distant branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
Hell's encompassing in 29:54 may indicate present spatial enclosure, rhetorical certainty, or both.
The causal arrow from self-wronging to self-siting is coherent but inferred rather than grammatically asserted.
The motion-versus-settlement contrast with 29:69 may be a deliberate closing antithesis or a reader-constructed linkage between adjacent promises.
